payload.question: How many new homes were finished in the city?
payload.label: New homes completed, council and private, 2024/25
payload.council_caveat: The council publishes these numbers as screenshots of a dashboard inside a PDF, so they cannot be read by machine. We read them off the images by eye, which is why this measure is flagged for human checking.
payload.evidence: This counts every new home finished in Norwich, private builders included, so it is only partly in the council's hands — its levers are planning permission and its own building programme. The target is 477 a year, the intervention level 429, and the figure reported for 2024/25 was 246.
